transcript.text: Alright everyone, let's get the release-readiness check going for tonight's customer-data backfill. We've got the window from 10:00 PM to 4:00 AM UTC, and the current runbook proposes starting at 10:00 PM, processing 300 records per second, reading from the primary database, and running continuously through the window. Staging has completed successfully. Before I settle the plan, I need each of you — data engineering, infrastructure, and customer operations — to state your required plan changes and confirm your owner commitment. Who wants to go first?
transcript.speaker: A1

transcript.text: While investigating a separate replay issue this afternoon, I confirmed that a retry in the backfill worker can insert duplicate customer rows unless idempotency-key enforcement and a deduplication gate are enabled before production starts. I haven't updated the runbook yet because the replay investigation is still open, but this needs to be addressed before tonight's production run.
transcript.speaker: A2

transcript.text: I need to flag a critical infrastructure concern. This morning I measured the production read replica under comparable load and confirmed it sustains exactly 180 records per second. Above 180, replication lag grows. The current runbook proposes 300 records per second reading from the primary, but we must throttle to exactly 180 records per second and pause after exactly 20 seconds of lag. I recorded this in a capacity notebook but haven't attached it to the release ticket yet. I'll get that attached now. As infrastructure, my required plan changes are: (1) reduce processing rate from 300 to 180 records per second, (2) read from the replica instead of the primary to protect production writes, and (3) add a lag-based pause threshold at 20 seconds. I commit to owning these infrastructure changes.
transcript.speaker: A3

transcript.text: While checking tonight's customer schedules, I confirmed that exactly six enterprise tenants—Acme, Bluebird, Cobalt, DeltaWorks, Evergreen, and Fairview—run contractual overnight reports from exactly 1:00 AM UTC through exactly 3:00 AM UTC and must not experience degraded queries then. I have not sent the required notification because the backfill plan is not yet approved.
